reason: An AI orchestration plugin for Minecraft that lets DSH agents operate a Mineflayer bot, analyze game data and screenshots, control the game, and manage installation and launching through a built-in launcher.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供 Minecraft AI 代理、游戏数据分析、视觉与键鼠控制，以及版本安装、登录和启动功能。
summaries.en: Provides a DeepSeek Harness Minecraft agent with game-data analysis, visual and keyboard-mouse control, plus version installation, authentication, and game launching.

capabilities: Launches and terminates Java Minecraft processes
Downloads Minecraft versions, libraries, and assets from documented Mojang endpoints
Performs Microsoft device-code authentication and stores account tokens locally
Reads Minecraft logs, crash reports, save statistics, and mod metadata
Controls Minecraft through simulated keyboard and mouse input
Connects to Minecraft over LAN using Mineflayer to read and modify game state
Sends screenshots to DashScope for visual analysis when configured
